scope: Reusable support red-black tree; dynamic kernel virtual address pool; kernel stack reservation, publication, reclamation and failure rollback

implementation.first_fit_and_interval_changes: O(log N) using subtree maximum free length and address-ordered trees
implementation.empty_metadata_pages: Immediately reclaimed using per-page usage and doubly linked page lists
implementation.empty_upper_page_tables: Detached, fenced and reclaimed after last child; running owners pin their live paths
implementation.fault_path: No interval-tree traversal, metadata allocation or management lock

rb_tree_sanitizers.checks: ASan/UBSan: ordered insert/delete, 30000 random operations, ordering, parent links, red/black constraints, black heights and subtree aggregates

validation.pool_contract: 20000 randomized operations against a model; 40000 allocations; fragmentation, coalescing, exhaustion, exact ownership, metadata OOM atomicity, OOM-safe release, empty slab reclamation and reset
validation.qemu_stack_probes: Locked growth, mapped read-only protection, emergency exhaustion, guard overflow, 1000 stack allocations/fragmentation/reuse with exact physical-page restoration, and 0..12-page allocation budgets with rollback/recovery
validation.qemu_stack_probe_scope: 1000 kernel stacks, not 1000 processes; running diagnostic stack is precommitted before resource accounting; the 1000-stack probe uses 256 MiB RAM to allow the supported 64 MiB reservation configuration, other probes use 128 MiB

flow_source_check.caveat: Source/binding integrity is evidence of reviewed coverage, not proof of runtime semantics or every build profile.

regression_caught_and_fixed: An initial regression retained 20 physical pages after usertests. Empty metadata slabs and upper directories are now reclaimed; coalescing preserves existing free descriptors instead of stranding them in temporary slabs. Final 1000-stack probe restores the exact initial free-page count.
limitations: The address pool has a finite virtual window and needs physical memory for live metadata; partially occupied metadata pages can have internal fragmentation.
Stack capacity and equal guard size still follow XV_KERNEL_STACK_MIB; growth commits pages only within that reservation.
Process counts remain constrained by process-table capacity and physical memory; this does not establish a 1000-process runtime claim.
Existing process ownership and TLB-fencing protocol is retained; shared-address-space threads and remote TLB shootdown are not added.
Existing platform RAM bound and LAB_LOCK build limitations remain unchanged.
No aggregate throughput or worst-case stack measurement; image-size changes are not a zero-overhead claim.
checkpoint: Virtual-address-pool implementation before selectable scheduling/container follow-up
